public_rationale: The participant-level data reproduce four of 25 experts with LLM access versus one of 25 without it reaching an accuracy score of at least 8 on formulation. That is 16% versus 4%, an observed ratio of four. This supports Marcus's stated interpretation of the sample counts. It does not establish a fourfold population effect or successful physical pathogen production.
limitations: The result depends on the contextual meaning of success as reaching the 8/10 threshold.
Only five experts crossed that threshold across both groups.
The numerical sources are CSV files, so their quotations reproduce complete records rather than prose sentences.
The publication and linked files were retrieved from their current locations; a separately timestamped release-day archive was not authenticated.
